headline: Authorizing the city to acquire 98 Maverick Street, Fitchburg, for One Dollar.
summary: The order lets the Mayor sign any papers needed for the purchase. It refers to a deed recorded in the Worcester North Registry of Deeds, Book 1309, Page 167.
items: Order 186-26 to acquire 98 Maverick Street for One Dollar
Mayor to sign documents and take other needed actions to carry out the order
location: Legislative Building, 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA
plain_text:
CITY OF FITCHBURG 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING 
 
*Please note: Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requires that all topics that the Chair reasonably anticipates must be listed and 
that the list of topics must be sufficiently specific to reasonably inform the public of the issues to be discussed at the me eting. 
CITY PROPERTY COMMITTEE 
AGENDA 
MEETING DATE:   Tuesday, November 17, 2026  
MEETING TIME:  5:30 PM  
MEETING PLACE: LEGISLATIVE BUILDING  
MEETING ADDRESS: 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA  
COMMITTEE MEMBERS: 
Chair Van Hazinga, Beauchemin, Cragin, 
Green and Starr 
 
AGENDA ITEMS:   
  
 
 
This meeting will be open to the public. 
 
*Council as a Whole Meeting 
 
Approval of the Minutes: October 6, 2026  
 
 
186-26. ORDER THAT:  AN ORDER TO AUTHORIZE THE ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY  
LOCATED AT 98 MAVERICK STREET. 
 
THAT the City Council of the City of Fitchburg adopts this Order to authorize the Mayor to 
acquire for One Dollar, the land known as 98 Maverick Street, Fitchburg, Massachusetts, as 
more particularly described in a deed recorded in the Worcester North Registry of Deeds in 
Book 1309, Page 167, appended hereto, and to authorize the Mayor to execute any documents 
necessary to effectuate the purposes of this vote: and 
 
THAT, Mayor is authorized to take any other action necessary or convenient to carry out this 
order.  
 *This notice is provided in the event that a quorum of the City Council is present at this standing committee 
meeting, thereby constituting a Committee of the Whole. If fewer than a quorum of the City Council is 
present, no Committee of the Whole meeting shall be convened. If a quorum is present, the Committee of the 
Whole shall be limited strictly to the standing committee agenda items listed above. 
Per Order: 
Andrew J. Van Hazinga, Chair, City Property Committee 
By: 
 
Joanna Bilotta-Simeone, City Clerk 
 
 
Filed in the City Clerk’s Office:
